title: Review: jmap-mail-server pass 12
notes:
Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: calculateTotal compliance impact (depends on client behavior), BackendSetError::Other intent in mailbox.rs (may be intentional defensive abort). Uncertainty driven by: no integration test with a full JMAP client, no test exercising calculateTotal=false, no test exercising non-string upToId. Would raise confidence if: tests for each filed issue existed.
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — calculateTotal gap is a silent spec violation that will generate user confusion when a compliant client omits it and gets unexpected data. The BackendSetError::Other inconsistency will confuse contributors implementing new handlers.
Idiom rating: CLEAN — no unsafe, no unwrap in hot paths, ownership model is correct. The sort+dedup and unwrap_or issues are minor. All other Rust patterns are idiomatic.
